      barcode = new.barcode,
      email = new.email,
      phone = new.phone,
      address = new.address,
      municipality = new.municipality,

      institution = new.institution,
      id_verification = new.id_verification,
      emergency_contact_name = new.emergency_contact_name,
      guardian = new.guardian
  WHERE rowid = old.rowid;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members_fts" USING fts5(full_name, barcode, email, phone, address, municipality, occupation, institution, id_verification, emergency_contact_name, guardian, tokenize = 'trigram remove_diacritics 1');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "loan_period_days" INTEGER NULL, "borrowing_limit" INTEGER NULL, "renewal_limit" INTEGER NULL, "renewal_period_days" INTEGER NULL, "fine_per_day" INTEGER NULL, "grace_days" INTEGER NULL, "maximum_fine_per_copy" INTEGER NULL, "max_outstanding_fine" INTEGER NULL, "membership_duration_months" INTEGER NULL, "reservation_limit" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES member_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "gender" TEXT NULL, "date_of_birth" TEXT NULL, "blood_group" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "municipality" TEXT NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "institution" TEXT NULL, "id_verification" TEXT NULL, "emergency_contact_name" TEXT NULL, "emergency_contact_phone" TEXT NULL, "guardian" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "joined_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "suspended_at" TEXT NULL, "suspension_reason" TEXT NULL, "send_notices" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("send_notices" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER members_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON members BEGIN INSERT INTO members_fts ("rowid", full_name, barcode, email, phone, address, municipality, occupation, institution, id_verification, emergency_contact_name, guardian) VALUES (new."rowid", new.full_name, new.barcode, new.email, new.phone, new.address, new.municipality, new.occupation, new.institution, new.id_verification, new.emergency_contact_name, new.guardian);END

CREATE TRIGGER members_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF full_name, barcode, email, phone, address, municipality, occupation, institution, id_verification, emergency_contact_name, guardian ON members BEGIN UPDATE members_fts SET full_name = new.full_name, barcode = new.barcode, email = new.email, phone = new.phone, address = new.address, municipality = new.municipality, occupation = new.occupation, institution = new.institution, id_verification = new.id_verification, emergency_contact_name = new.emergency_contact_name, guardian = new.guardian WHERE "rowid" = old."rowid";END
CREATE TRIGGER members_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON members BEGIN DELETE FROM members_fts WHERE "rowid" = old."rowid";END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX members_barcode ON members (barcode)
CREATE INDEX members_type ON members (member_type_id)
CREATE INDEX members_expiry ON members (expires_at) WHERE archived_at IS NULL
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "titles_fts" USING fts5(title, author, isbn, publisher, shelf, tokenize = 'trigram remove_diacritics 1');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "title_formats" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "titles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "published_year" INTEGER NULL, "edition" TEXT NULL, "pages" INTEGER NULL, "format_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES title_formats (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'English', "description" TEXT NULL, "shelf" TEXT NULL, "lendable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("lendable" IN (0, 1)), "replacement_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (published_year IS NULL OR (published_year >= 1000 AND published_year <= 2200)), CHECK (pages IS NULL OR pages > 0));

CREATE TRIGGER titles_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON titles BEGIN INSERT INTO titles_fts ("rowid", title, author, isbn, publisher, shelf) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.author, new.isbn, new.publisher, new.shelf);END

CREATE TRIGGER titles_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, author, isbn, publisher, shelf ON titles BEGIN UPDATE titles_fts SET title = new.title, author = new.author, isbn = new.isbn, publisher = new.publisher, shelf = new.shelf WHERE "rowid" = old."rowid";END
CREATE TRIGGER titles_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON titles BEGIN DELETE FROM titles_fts WHERE "rowid" = old."rowid";END
CREATE INDEX titles_format ON titles (format_id)
CREATE INDEX titles_isbn ON titles (isbn) WHERE isbn IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX titles_sort ON titles (title)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "opening_hours" TEXT NULL, "barcode_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'KH-', "barcode_next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "logo_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff_recovery_codes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES staff (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "code_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "used_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loan_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "loan_period_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14, "borrowing_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "renewal_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "renewal_period_days" INTEGER NULL, "fine_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500, "grace_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "maximum_fine_per_copy" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50000, "max_outstanding_fine" INTEGER NULL, "membership_duration_months" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12, "reservation_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "hold_shelf_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "block_overdue_borrowers" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("block_overdue_borrowers" IN (0, 1)), "auto_renew_when_unreserved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_renew_when_unreserved" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "copies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES titles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "barcode" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "shelf" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "acquired_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "copy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES copies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "checked_out_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "returned_at" TEXT NULL, "renewal_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "return_condition" TEXT NULL, "checked_out_by_staff_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES staff (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "returned_by_staff_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES staff (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "rule_loan_period_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rule_fine_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rule_grace_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rule_maximum_fine" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "loan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES loans (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "assessed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "waived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "raised_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "settled_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (assessed >= 0), CHECK (paid >= 0), CHECK (waived >= 0), CHECK (paid + waived <= assessed));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reservations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES titles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "placed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "ready_copy_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES copies (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "ready_at" TEXT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((closed_at IS NULL) = (status IN ('waiting', 'ready'))));
CREATE INDEX staff_recovery_codes_staff ON staff_recovery_codes (staff_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copies_barcode ON copies (barcode)
CREATE INDEX copies_status ON copies (status) WHERE archived_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX copies_title ON copies (title_id, archived_at, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX loans_one_open_per_copy ON loans (copy_id) WHERE returned_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX loans_open_by_member ON loans (member_id, due_at) WHERE returned_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX loans_due ON loans (due_at) WHERE returned_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX loans_member_history ON loans (member_id, checked_out_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX loans_copy_history ON loans (copy_id, checked_out_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX loans_checked_out ON loans (checked_out_at)
CREATE INDEX loans_returned ON loans (returned_at) WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX fines_outstanding ON fines (member_id) WHERE paid + waived < assessed
CREATE INDEX fines_member ON fines (member_id, raised_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX fines_raised ON fines (raised_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reservations_one_active_per_member_title ON reservations (title_id, member_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX reservations_queue ON reservations (title_id, placed_at) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX reservations_member ON reservations (member_id, placed_at)
